head: a8fa4cfdb815b0c1e087dc0908d097c5fc04ca68
summary: I built the design's test-only change. The tree held no earlier build work (only the repro project and scratch), and `FsAnalyser.slnx` built clean before I edited anything. A 3-row Theory in `LastAccessTests` pins the attribute gate. A dedicated admin-share Fact in `LastAccessTests`, plus asserts added to the layer-store admin-share Fact and the opt-in `StalledShareTests`, pin the remote gate. I committed `Mutants.ps1` (M1), which applies mutants A, B and the three bit-drops to a copy of the tree and checks that exactly the intended tests go red. The suite is 874/874 green under both TEMPs and the SL-102 repro passes. The mutant driver exits 0, and a negative check made it exit 1 when the Theory's Asked assertion was removed. I could not run the SMB-LOOPBACK assert; it stays the person's check. `src` is untouched.

files.why: Adds the 3-row cloud-attribute Theory (Offline, 0x80000, 0x100000) and the dedicated admin-share Fact asserting Asked and Kept are 0.
Adds Asked and Kept == 0 asserts on `above` and `throughLink` in the existing admin-share Fact.
Adds the opt-in SMB-LOOPBACK Asked and Kept == 0 assert after AssertChildrenAreContiguous, and a remark saying why a person runs it.
Committed mutant driver (M1): mutants as data, copy of the tree, absolute targets, exactly-one-match, DLL time check, both TEMPs, failure-set comparison, src untouched at the end.

obligations.how: The Offline row of the Theory LastAccessTests.AFolderWithACloudAttributeIsNotAskedToKeepItsLastAccessTimeButIsStillEntered. It checks the listing precondition, Completed, Bytes 4 and Asked 3. Green under both TEMPs. Mutant A and the Offline bit-drop each turn that row red.
The (FileAttributes)0x80000 PINNED row of the same Theory. Green under both TEMPs. Mutant A and the Pinned bit-drop each turn that row red, and no other.
The (FileAttributes)0x100000 UNPINNED row of the same Theory. Green under both TEMPs. Mutant A and the Unpinned bit-drop each turn that row red, and no other.
Each Theory row asserts Totals.Bytes == 4 (off\one.txt and off\inner\two.txt counted) and Asked == 3, so off\inner is still asked while off is left out.

The Theory rows are literal values. Mutants.ps1 drops each bit (Offline, Pinned, Unpinned) from CloudFolderAttributes in the copy. Under both TEMPs only that bit's row goes red and 874 tests execute each time.

Mutants.ps1 mutant A (the `|| (attributes & CloudFolderAttributes) != 0` clause deleted) turns exactly the 3 Theory rows red under both TEMPs. The unmutated run is 874/874 and every mutant run executes 874.

Asked and Kept == 0 on `above` in ContainerLayerStoreTests.AScanThroughThisPcsAdminShareRefusesInsideTheStoreAndSkipsItFromAbove. The Fact takes its share branch on this PC. Also in the new LastAccessTests.NothingOnThisPcsAdminShareIsAskedToKeepItsLastAccessTime.
Asked and Kept == 0 on `throughLink` in the same admin-share Fact. Green under both TEMPs.

Mutants.ps1 mutant B (remote hard-wired to false) turns exactly two tests red under both TEMPs: ContainerLayerStoreTests.AScanThroughThisPcsAdminShare... and LastAccessTests.NothingOnThisPcsAdminShareIsAskedToKeepItsLastAccessTime. Unmutated is 874/874.

The StalledShareTests asserts sit in the existing Trait Network=SMB-LOOPBACK test, so no Trait or Skip was added. The default `FsAnalyser.slnx` run executed 874 tests, none from StalledShareTests, and OptInTraitTests passes 10/10.
The SL-102 repro (case 14) exits 0 against the edited tree. Its regex reader accepts the [Theory] with [InlineData] rows and the asserts inside the share Facts. The repro file is unedited.

Committed tests/bugs/SL-102-LastAccessGatesAssertions/Mutants.ps1 as the one command for the mutant cases. It holds the mutants and their expected red sets as data, copies the tree (`git ls-files`) into a new folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp, and refuses a target at or under the worktree or the copy's root. It requires exactly one match, builds with --no-incremental, requires the test-bin FsAnalyser.Core.dll to be newer than the edit, runs the suite under both TEMPs and compares the failure set exactly. It ends with `git diff --exit-code src` and a src hash check. Full run exit 0; negative check exit 1.

mutation.find: Assert.Equal(3, result.LastAccessAsked); // the root, a and off\inner; not off

obligations.how: The design record (contract, key decision, outside_claims) is not in this repo and build cannot edit it, so the corrected wording is recorded here. The SMB-LOOPBACK run is a person's because New-SmbMapping changes machine state and stages may not do it (#120, CC-006). It needs Windows 11 24H2+. Only under Windows Sandbox's SYSTEM does it additionally fail with error 1312. The same wording is now in the StalledShareTests class remarks. filed_for_later is unchanged.
obligations.not_mutable: A comment and a record wording; no test can observe either.

obligations.how: The Theory uses `TempTree.AddAttributes(tree.PathOf("off"), attribute)` (static) and the precondition `Assert.Equal(attribute, (FileAttributes)Scans.Listing(tree.Root)["off"].Attributes & attribute)`. It compiles, and the precondition is live in every row.
obligations.not_mutable: The defect was a compile error in the design text. The code compiles, so there is no behaviour a test could observe going wrong.

obligations.how: The Theory's remark gives the real reasons for the hex literals: System.IO.FileAttributes has no Pinned or Unpinned member, and rows must not be derived from the mask under test. It claims no 'likeliest regression' ranking. Each row is justified by the single-bit kills the driver measures. The design record's wording cannot be edited by build and is left to its owner.
obligations.not_mutable: A comment and a record wording; no test can observe either.

obligations.how: Added LastAccessTests.NothingOnThisPcsAdminShareIsAskedToKeepItsLastAccessTime. It scans a plain TempTree (a\one.txt, b\one.txt, b\inner\two.txt) through \\localhost\ and \\127.0.0.1\ admin shares, with the same Directory.Exists skip. It asserts Completed, Bytes 4 and (Asked, Kept) == (0, 0). The ContainerLayerStoreTests asserts stay. The driver's expected red set for mutant B names both Facts.
obligations.not_mutable: Mutant B has two witnesses, so removing either one's assertion leaves the other red and no single test then fails; the driver's exact-set comparison for mutant B is the check.

tests.note: Run before any edit: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
22/22, run after the first edits and before the Theory's tree was trimmed to its final shape. The final shape is covered by the driver's baseline.
1/1, exit 0, run again after the last edit. Before the build it failed with '2 of 2 unasserted'.

Final run, exit 0. Unmutated 874/874 under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp. Mutant A turned red exactly the 3 Theory rows. Mutant B turned red exactly the two admin-share Facts. Each bit-drop turned red only its own row. Every mutant run executed 874 tests, the Core.dll was newer than each edit, `git diff --exit-code src` returned 0, and the src hash matched. No copy was left behind.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/bugs/SL-102-LastAccessGatesAssertions/Mutants.ps1 -Mutant A -Temp Ordinary (with the Theory's Asked assertion temporarily replaced by Assert.True(result.LastAccessAsked >= 0))
tests.note: Negative check: mutant A survived at 874/874, the driver reported FAIL and exited 1. LastAccessTests.cs was restored byte-for-byte afterwards. Passed means the driver failed as intended.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test FsAnalyser.slnx --logger trx
tests.note: The way the suite ships: 874/874, exit 0. StalledShareTests executed 0 times and OptInTraitTests passed 10/10. This run was before the Theory's tree was trimmed to its final shape; the final run of the driver covers that. No product code changed, so the App was not launched.
Not run: New-SmbMapping changes this machine's SMB mappings and stages may not do that. It is filed as the person's check; the spike measured asked 0 unmutated and 3 under mutant B as a local user.

deviations: Mutants.ps1 copies the tree with `git ls-files` (tracked, including uncommitted edits, plus untracked outside .taad and .taad-scratch) instead of the design's `git archive HEAD`. The new tests are uncommitted while the build runs, so an archive of HEAD would not contain them.
The share asserts are one tuple assertion, `Assert.Equal((0, 0), (x.LastAccessAsked, x.LastAccessKept))`, not four separate Assert.Equal lines. The repro's regex reader accepts the form.

Added the dedicated LastAccessTests admin-share Fact (accepted finding m4 / O-019) with the ContainerLayerStoreTests asserts kept. Mutant B therefore has two witnesses, and the driver's expected set names both.

Accepted finding m5 (two plain subfolders under `off`) is not built. Its obligation O-020 was waived and carried to SC-298, so the Theory keeps the design's measured shape: one `off\inner` subfolder, Bytes 4, Asked 3. A gate shifted one level still reads 3 and is not caught yet.

The corrections for m1 (SYSTEM wording) and m3 (PINNED rationale) belong to the design record (contract, key decision, outside_claims, prior_art), which is outside this repo and cannot be edited by a build. The correct reasoning is in the StalledShareTests remarks and the Theory's remark; the design text itself still carries the old wording.
Design contract names the repro as `...Tests.csproj`; that file exists and is the one used. The survey's `SL-102-LastAccessGatesAssertions.csproj` does not exist.
not_built: The SMB-LOOPBACK run and a proof that its new assert bites. It changes machine SMB state and is filed as the person's check; only the spike's sandbox measurement exists.

Rows for RECALL_ON_OPEN and RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS. NTFS drops both bits from user-mode SetFileAttributes, so only the CF-SYNC-ROOT rig could set them. Mutant A is already killed by the three settable bits.
A case for a scan root that itself carries a cloud attribute (the ListRoot caller). It was not named by O-029 and not spiked; filed.
Making the admin-share Facts fail rather than skip when no admin share answers. That changes SL-095's semantics and is filed.
The shifted-gate shape of m5 (two plain subfolders), waived to SC-298.
Any architecture-record edit. This slice makes no sentence of any block untrue.
follow_ups: SC-298: give `off` two plain subfolders (correct count 4, a gate shifted one level reads 3, mutant A reads 5) so a shifted gate is caught.

A person runs the SMB-LOOPBACK filter once under a real user logon (`eng/dotnet.ps1 test FsAnalyser.slnx --filter "Network=SMB-LOOPBACK&FullyQualifiedName~StalledShareTests"`) to confirm the new asserts pass unmutated, then checks no \\127.0.0.1\fsa<8hex> mapping remains.
Run the two admin-share Facts, and the mutant B kill, on Windows 10 and on a PC or account where \\localhost\C$ does not answer. There the Facts skip silently and mutant B survives the default suite.
Make the skipped-host branch visible, for example by counting the hosts reached, in the admin-share Facts.
Pin the scan-root caller of the attribute gate (ListRoot, Scanner.cs:241): a scan whose root itself carries OFFLINE, PINNED or UNPINNED.
Assert the RECALL_ON_OPEN and RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS bits through the opt-in CF-SYNC-ROOT rig.
Validate should run Mutants.ps1 once (about 10 minutes for all mutants and both TEMPs, or `-Mutant B -Temp Ordinary` for about 2 minutes) as the check for the mutant cases.
